crossRefs.note: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to…
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
translations.bsb: So Moses stretched out his staff over the land of Egypt, and throughout that day and night the LORD sent an east wind across the land. By morning the east wind had brought the locusts.
translations.kjv: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
translations.asv: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and Jehovah brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all the night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
